notes.title: Major Update: Synthetic Squad Update
notes.notes: [p]Welcome Commanders, it's time for a major update![/p][p][/p][p]The [b]Synthetic Division, our 3rd squad,[/b] comes into the game! This patch will introduce our new deadly squad, which we hope you will enjoy playing and taking on challenges with. And of course, a bunch of new commands, fixes and changes to discover right here![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016668/3ef33f900264b20b19991d5cd27c1fc47ba97c25.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2]The Synthetic Squad[/h2][p]The Synthetic Squad has not 1, not 2, but 3 special rules that set them apart from all the rest:[/p][list][*][p]They are Androids, meaning they outperform all regular Soldiers. This is reflected in the stats across the board.[/p][/*][*][p]Being an Android is not all nice. Androids cannot heal by regular means, meaning they can’t get any of the healing Commands. Instead of repairing an Android, you must spend Credits through the Asset Management screen.[/p][/*][*][p]They have access to Breach Protocols Commands. When they explore the room, they get to provide Access Points to the Commander, allowing for the use of unique commands that manipulate the Hulk.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Check out our video on the Squad #3: The Synthetic Division:[/h3][previewyoutube="x6EE8dkQ1fo;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]New Commands[/h2][p]With this new squad, we are adding 6 powerful commands to take advantage and keep control of your mission: [/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Hack Doors:[/b] This is the bread and butter of Synthetic Squad. It allows Androids to avoid unnecessary combat, while also setting up for Ingite and Vent Room if things take a more drastic turn.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016668/447cea4a85ab64dd0aa339f52fe78741d2384b05.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Download Schematics:[/b] Getting to see the entire Hulk structure early can provide a lot of advantages. It’s also a great way to get access to the following Breach Protocols across the entire level.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016668/e8aec634723c55f0f7f17508382482275e2a44f2.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Pull Camera Recordings:[/b] Exploring faster means you get to be more efficient.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016668/e7c225d8d0aad4b1cd682ddea2205fc5b493e402.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Subsonic Disruption:[/b] Coming face-to-face suddenly with a Xenos Spawner can be devastating for the Androids. You now get to stall enemy waves to get out of such situations.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016668/ae5927e96d19cdb3e567e336f000b24825080041.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Ignite Room and Decompress Room:[/b] Dealing with Xenos without even engaging with them is the best way to avoid damaging your precious Androids.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016668/1c1dc9a6ade1230a2357f5fc6342c66743e18c51.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016668/04c1b2ee3c81502be4804b5439714e392d97eb08.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Addition of four new commander ranks, in which all of the above are distributed as rewards.[/p][/*][*][p]The graphics of the explored tiles to be more distinct.[/p][/*][*][p]Both the current and max HP of soldiers are now shown on the UI.[/p][/*][*][p]The buttons for Next Page/ Previous Page (Q/E) are now shown in the battlescreen footer. They move the cursor by 10 positions, extra helpful in the new room-centric squad.[/p][/*][*][p]Hive will now remain seen once it is explored, even if it is out of sight. Remember, you can use Focus to get to it![/p][/*][*][p]You can no longer give Recon to units if the entire hulk is explored, and added a tooltip for it.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Fixed[/h2][list][*][p]There was an Elite mission that required a package delivery and 5 intel collections. It was meant to be 3 Intel.[/p][/*][*][p]There was a challenge at rank 6 that was supposed to award the Recon Specter Gear, but it was bugged.[/p][/*][*][p]Flash Grenade conferred -2 Speed instead of -4 as it was described.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Balancing[/h2][list][*][p]Changed the purchase cost of the following Commands: Flash Grenade, Mine, Head to Room, First Aid Kit, Retask (Overwatch) 3 → 2[/p][/*][*][p]We decided to boost the loadout of the Sentinel squad. They now start with the Inject Kinetra command.[/p][/*][*][p]MASS Carbine was not delivering to our expectations. It now fires 2 shots per action, allowing it to take out Scouts at 5 tiles away with each of those shots, and making it the highest DPS in the game. Cost 4 → 8[/p][/*][*][p]The SAP Rifle’s cost no longer makes sense compared to the other weapons. Cost 6 → 4.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the damage from the Mine from 25 → 30. Now it can take out Maulers.[/p][/*][*][p]Last update, we reduced the Mine activation time in order to make it more viable when placed on Xenos spawn points. It made it kinda pointless in all other cases so we reverted the change. Mine countdown 0.75 → 2.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the AoE damage from the Kinetic Warhammer 2 → 5.[/p][/*][*][p]We are trying to avoid nerfs generally, but this was needed. Speed scaling is being reduced. Each point of speed will now impact the duration of actions less 0.25 → 0.15. This sure seems like a big change, but we find it necessary in order to allow for diverse strategies and builds to shine.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]What's next?[/h2][p]So in the past 2 months, we have received hundreds of bug reports and comments, and we want you to know you have read them all. [b]Every single one.[/b] If you have sent something and it hasn’t been done yet, we ask for just a bit more patience. We will now be focusing on all that feedback. Thank you for supporting Xenopurge with your reviews and words of encouragement; they fuel our passion. See you soon and stay tuned for the 1.0 release![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/vAxw2ZY4yT" style="button"]Discord[/url]  [url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Firesquid" style="button"]Steam[/url]  [/p]

notes.title: First patch + Early Access Roadmap
notes.notes:
[h2]Features/ Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Added the options to disable motion blur, screen effects and camera effects. If you filly dizzy during camera movement disable the motion blur, if your eyes get tired due to the effects try to tone down the camera effects, and to improve readability disable the screen effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Raised the volume on the Mine SFX.[/p][/*][*][p]We changed all soldier names to only include the surname to aid readability and clarity.[/p][/*][*][p]The Package now appears next to the carrier’s name to aid in visibility.[/p][/*][*][p]Made some minor changes in the room and added a nice animation for the monitors.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Balancing[/h2][list][*][p]The BOLT SMG was a bit busted, we changed the bonus from the ability +2 Speed and +20 ACC → +1 Speed and +10 ACC.[/p][/*][*][p]Cloning costs reduced by 1 credit. This should help across all difficulties and squads.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the amount of shots of the shotgun from 2x6dmg to 3x4dmg to improve consistency.[/p][/*][*][p]We increased the max difficulty of the waves. This shouldn’t matter unless you stay in a mission for more than 6 waves.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the penalty from the Combat Shield -2 Power → -1 Power.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bugs[/h2][list][*][p]Optimal ranges were 1 tile shorter than it was displayed. We fixed that, which should improve the usability of all short ranged weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Starting enemies and spawning enemies on the last 3 missions of Sector Draconis have been reduced.[/p][/*][*][p]Ukranian instead of Russian was used in the End Battle Screen. Fixed.
[/p][/*][/list][h1][b]So where the roadmap?[/b][/h1][p]
We won’t be releasing a big roadmap until we get the most critical issues out of the way (which won’t be long). We will then prioritise the oncoming content by looking at the community’s requests and combining it with our own designs. You can find more about this here:
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2983410/view/517465051240596025?l=english"][/dynamiclink]With the release of Xenopurge the 11th of July, we know many of you have questions about our game. This FAQ gathers the most important information to help you better understand...[/p][p]
So what are focusing on now? We want to make the game as accessible and user friendly as possible, so this means:[/p][list][*][p]Full Steam Deck Compatibility[/p][/*][*][p]Optimisation[/p][/*][*][p]Accessibility options and Settings(Screen effects, Resolutions etc)[/p][/*][*][p]Keybindings[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Cloud Save

We are checking and evaluating every single piece of feedback. The best place for us is discord, so we can ask questions, check images etc, but Steam Forums and ingame Bug Report tool(make sure you include images and the log) are also fine. [b]To put it simply TALK TO US.[/b] We are a small team but we are passionate, we’ll be providing updates as regularly as possible. If you like where Xenopurge is heading you can support us with your Steam reviews, they make a big difference for us.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Xenopurge Release FAQ
notes.notes:
[h1]Release FAQ[/h1][p][/p][p]With the release of Xenopurge [b]the 11th of July[/b], we know many of you have questions about our game. This FAQ gathers the most important information to help you better understand what to expect on launch day.  [/p][h3]
[u][b]What is Xenopurge?[/b][/u][/h3][p]Xenopurge is a tactical auto-battler where you take on the role of a Commander tasked with purging the Xenos threat. Operate from a remote command center, issuing orders via multi-screen interfaces. Plan routes, set priorities, and adapt as missions escalate — and feel the true weight of being in command.[/p][h3]
[u][b]What kind of autobattler Xenopurge is?[/b][/u][/h3][p]Xenopurge is not your typical autobattler. It blends several systems where you don't control units directly, but assign them “behaviors” which they execute according to situational factors. Your role is to predict outcomes, adapt, and adjust your squad's approach as conditions evolve.[/p][p]To simplify:
 [b]50% autobattler, 20% squad management, 15% tactical, 15% simulation[/b] — all designed to simulate the experience of being a remote commander.[/p][p]Unlike most autobattlers, you manage an entire squad whose synergies emerge from coordination and positioning rather than stacking builds on individual units. Balancing exploration, covering ground, distributing resources, and handling combat all work together to form your strategic puzzle.[/p][h3]
[u][b]What makes Xenopurge unique compared to other Real Time Tactics games?[/b][/u][/h3][p]In most tactical games, players have ample time to make precise decisions with predictable outcomes. In Xenopurge, you make rapid decisions under pressure, with outcomes that are uncertain, forcing you to adapt constantly. It’s designed to simulate the tension and limited control of commanding remotely.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016668/f0f0de04861bf81d31c797d43ace51dad591e925.jpg"][/img][/p][h3] [u][b]Is Xenopurge launching in Early Access or as a full release, and why?[/b][/u][/h3][p]Xenopurge is launching in [b]Early Access[/b]. After 6 months of internal and limited community playtesting, we’re ready to open it up to a wider audience. Early Access allows us to gather feedback, tune systems, and shape the remaining content together with the community.[/p][p]Content updates, quality of life improvements, customization, and accessibility options will all be prioritized based on player feedback.[/p][p]We don’t expect Early Access to last long — we are targeting 1.0 release within 2025 with enough content and replayability for many hours of gameplay.[/p][h3]
[u][b]When will the game be released?[/b][/u][/h3][p]The game will be released on July 11th in Early Access.[/p][p][/p][h3][u][b]Which platforms will the game be available on?[/b][/u][/h3][p]The game will be available on PC on Steam.[/p][h3]
[u][b]How much is the game going to cost?[/b][/u][/h3][p]The game will cost 12.49 USD/ 12.49 Euros. [/p][h3]
[u][b]What kind of future content is planned?[/b][/u][/h3][p]At Early Access launch:[/p][list][*][p]2 playable squads[/p][/*][*][p]20 Commands[/p][/*][*][p]25 pieces of equipment[/p][/*][*][p]3 difficulty settings per squad[/p][/*][/list][p]This represents about [b]half[/b] of the planned content for version 1.0. New squads, equipment, commands, missions, and story content will be added regularly.[/p][p]While the first 2 squads serve as a solid introduction, the upcoming squads will introduce entirely new mechanics that dramatically change how the game is played.[/p][p]The story will unfold gradually, but remains optional for those who prefer pure tactical gameplay.[/p][h3]
[u][b]Which languages is the game going to support?[/b][/u][/h3][list][*][p]English[/p][/*][*][p]French[/p][/*][*][p]Spanish Latam[/p][/*][*][p]German[/p][/*][*][p]Polish[/p][/*][*][p]Greek[/p][/*][*][p]Brazilian[/p][/*][*][p]Ukrainian[/p][/*][*][p]Russian[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified chinese[/p][/*][*][p]Traditional chinese[/p][/*][/list][h3]
[u][b]Will Xenopurge be compatible with the Steam Deck?[/b][/u][/h3][p]Absolutely. Steam Deck support is already implemented and we plan to keep improving it to ensure the best experience possible.[/p][h3]
[u][b]Are all resolutions supported?[/b][/u][/h3][p]Yes — gameplay is fully scalable with no black bars or forced aspect ratios.[/p][h3]
[u][b]Are there accessibility options? (colorblind modes etc.)[/b][/u][/h3][p]Full mouse support (yes, we consider that accessibility!)
Controller is also supported already.[/p][p]
More accessibility options are planned, including:[/p][list][*][p]Alternative color schemes (colorblind support)[/p][/*][*][p]Rebindable controls[/p][/*][*][p]Additional control schemes[/p][/*][*][p]Pause functionality (yes, even that counts as accessibility in Xenopurge!)[/p][/*][/list][h3]
[u][b]Who is Traptics?[/b][/u][/h3][p]We’re a small game development studio from Greece. Currently a 4-person team, we specialize in tactical and strategy games with a unique twist, and we love building games together with our community through player feedback and engagement.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016668/fdeec261b508c96f31859f778a5dc0be73852f8f.png"][/img][/p][h3]
[u][b]Who is making the music?[/b][/u][/h3][p]All music, SFX, and audio design are produced in-house, primarily by Manu Charitakis. We’ve also collaborated with dozens of voice actors to create a tense, immersive atmosphere.[/p][h3]
[u][b]What are the inspirations for Xenopurge?[/b][/u][/h3][p]While we share some visual identity — keyboards, derelict spaceships, cold UIs — the gameplay is very different from Duskers. The biggest similarity is probably the focus on keyboard-driven controls and exploring abandoned ships.[/p][p]The core inspiration for Xenopurge comes from the [i]Aliens[/i] (1986) scene with Lieutenant Gorman and the APC: sitting behind monitors, hearing gunfire and screams, feeling helpless as the situation unravels. Our goal is to simulate that feeling — though, of course, a competent commander should never reach that point.[/p][p]We’ve also drawn inspiration from [i]Space Hulk[/i], [i]Warhammer 40K[/i], [i]Nemesis[/i] (board game), and [i]Beyond the Aquila Rift[/i], among others.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016668/b1903664a4b54871ef10da8c2fb041a24d6b4ae1.png"][/img][/p][h3]
[u][b]What is the story of Xenopurge? [/b][/u][/h3][p]We’re not going to spoil it. Story elements are discovered as you explore — or can be mostly ignored if you prefer to focus on pure gameplay. The choice is entirely yours.[/p][h3]
[u][b]Who is M.A.C.E?[/b][/u][/h3][p]M.A.C.E. stands for [b]Mercer’s Advanced Combat Enterprises[/b] — the conglomerate you work for as commander. They created the Xenopurge protocol to eliminate the Xenos threat. More details are revealed during gameplay.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016668/86a01c0ce01c23ea11bb04d35c41664c4f3a0b63.png"][/img][/p][h3]
[u][b]Will there be different game modes?[/b][/u][/h3][p]Xenopurge follows a roguelike structure: move through a mission map, engage in battles, collect resources, and ultimately face a final encounter. Multiple squads, unique playstyles, randomized maps, missions, and escalating difficulty ensure strong replayability.[/p][h3]
[u][b]What is the pacing of the game like?[/b][/u][/h3][p]Missions are paced slowly and steadily to allow for preparation and planning, but offer limited real-time reaction once engagements begin. The lack of a pause button increases tension and simulates the emergency conditions of remote command. Strategy matters far more than reflexes.[/p][h3]
[u][b]Can you customize your squad?[/b][/u][/h3][p]You can customize nearly all aspects of your squad’s loadout:[/p][list][*][p]Melee weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Ranged weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Armors[/p][/*][*][p]Combat logic upgrades[/p][/*][*][p]New commands[/p][/*][/list][p]However, squads retain their unique playstyles and core mechanics. Appearance and names are not customizable — your soldiers come as they are. A true commander learns to trust, love, or resent their team — they’re not dolls to dress up.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016668/113e156d051fecdf3ecb4eb3e7843edef50941cf.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][u][b]Will progress carry over from Early Access to 1.0?[/b][/u][/h3][p]We care about this very much. We will do our absolute best to retain that progress. However, during EA some runs might have to be restarted when new content drops. But the permanent progression will persist.[/p][p][/p][p]We wish you are as excited as we are for the release of Xenopurge, if you want to contribute more, you can [b]join our Discord[/b] server and chat with everyone![/p][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/vAxw2ZY4yT" style="button"]Discord[/url]  [url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Firesquid" style="button"]Steam[/url]
[/p]
